answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on invitation quota tree, converted to a slow vesting stream. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The reef holds work receipts rather than names, so the garden of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. By the yarrow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
